lines.t: I’d like to book for Tuesday the 12th. Oh, wait, no, Tuesday is the 11th, isn’t it? Yes, the 11th.
lines.say: I’d like to book for Tuesday the twelfth. Oh, wait, no, Tuesday is the eleventh, isn’t it? Yes, the eleventh.

items.q: Booking date: Tuesday ____ (write a number)

hint.ar: استمع حتى آخر الجملة؛ هل غيّرت المتحدثة الرقم؟
hint.en: Listen to the end — does she change the number?

why.ar: قالت ١٢ ثم صحّحت إلى ١١ وأكدته («Yes, the 11th»). القاعدة: الإجابة بعد التصحيح.
why.en: She said 12th, then corrected it to 11th and confirmed it. Rule: the answer comes after the correction.

lines.t: My surname’s Pearce. That’s P, E, A, R, C, E.
lines.say: My surname’s Pearce. That’s P, E, A, R, C, E.

items.q: Surname: ____

hint.ar: اكتب الحروف واحدًا واحدًا ولا تعتمد على شكل الاسم المألوف (Pierce).
hint.en: Write the letters one by one; don’t rely on a familiar spelling (Pierce).

why.ar: التهجئة P-E-A-R-C-E. كثير من الطلاب يكتبون Pierce لأنه أشهر، لكن التهجئة هي الحَكَم.
why.en: The spelling is P-E-A-R-C-E. Many write the more familiar Pierce, but the spelling decides.

lines.t: The tour costs fifteen pounds for adults, and children go free.
lines.say: The tour costs fifteen pounds for adults, and children go free.

items.q: Adult ticket: £____

hint.ar: أين الضغط في الرقم؟ في آخره (-teen) أم في أوله (-ty)؟
hint.en: Where is the stress: at the end (-teen) or the start (-ty)?

why.ar: fifTEEN بالضغط على المقطع الأخير = ١٥. أما FIFty فالضغط في أولها = ٥٠.
why.en: fifTEEN, stressed at the end, is 15; FIFty, stressed at the start, is 50.

lines.t: The postcode is GU9 7JE.
lines.say: The postcode is G, U, nine, seven, J, E.

items.q: Postcode: ____

hint.ar: انتبه للحرفين G (جي) وJ (جاي)، فهما الأكثر خلطًا.
hint.en: Watch G /dʒiː/ and J /dʒeɪ/ — the most confused pair.

why.ar: G تُنطق «جي» وJ تُنطق «جاي». الرمز GU9 7JE.
why.en: G is /dʒiː/, J is /dʒeɪ/. The postcode is GU9 7JE.

lines.t: A single room is ninety-five pounds a night, but if you stay three nights or more, it drops to eighty.
lines.say: A single room is ninety-five pounds a night, but if you stay three nights or more, it drops to eighty.

items.q: Price per night for a stay of four nights: £____

hint.ar: السؤال فيه شرط: أربع ليالٍ. أي السعرين ينطبق؟
hint.en: The question has a condition: four nights. Which price applies?

why.ar: أربع ليالٍ = «three nights or more»، فالسعر ٨٠. السعر الأول (٩٥) لإقامة أقصر.
why.en: Four nights counts as “three nights or more”, so £80. The first price (95) is for shorter stays.

lines.t: You can reach me on 07781 300462.
lines.say: You can reach me on oh seven seven eight one, three double oh, four six two.

items.q: Phone: ____

why.ar: oh seven seven eight one = 07781، three double oh four six two = 300462.
why.en: oh-seven-seven-eight-one = 07781; three-double-oh-four-six-two = 300462.

lines.t: The meeting’s in room 214… sorry, I mean 241. They swapped rooms last week.
lines.say: The meeting’s in room two one four… sorry, I mean two four one. They swapped rooms last week.

items.q: Room number: ____

why.ar: ٢١٤ خطأ صحّحه المتحدث إلى ٢٤١.
why.en: 214 was a slip; he corrected it to 241.

lines.t: Classes are on Wednesdays — not Thursdays any more — from half past six.
lines.say: Classes are on Wednesdays, not Thursdays any more, from half past six.

items.q: Day of classes: ____

hint.ar: توقّع: الفراغ بعد Day يعني يومًا من الأسبوع. أي يوم ما زال صحيحًا؟
hint.en: Predict: a day of the week. Which day is still correct?

why.ar: «not Thursdays any more» تعني أن الخميس كان سابقًا، فالإجابة الأربعاء.
why.en: “not Thursdays any more” means Thursday was before; the answer is Wednesday.

lines.t: The road is Bellingham Road. That’s B, E, double L, I, N, G, H, A, M.
lines.say: The road is Bellingham Road. That’s B, E, double L, I, N, G, H, A, M.

items.q: Address: 18 ____ Road

hint.ar: «double L» = حرفان LL. اكتب وأنت تسمع.
hint.en: “double L” = LL. Write as you listen.

why.ar: B-E-LL-I-N-G-H-A-M. لا تنسَ حرفي L.
why.en: B-E-LL-I-N-G-H-A-M — don’t miss the double L.

lines.t: Membership is forty pounds a year, or thirty for students, and full-time students also get a free locker.
lines.say: Membership is forty pounds a year, or thirty for students, and full-time students also get a free locker.

items.q: Student membership: £____ per year

hint.ar: حدد الفئة التي يسأل عنها السؤال: student.
hint.en: Find the group the question asks about: students.

why.ar: ٤٠ للعموم و٣٠ للطلاب. السؤال عن الطلاب.
why.en: £40 for everyone, £30 for students; the question asks about students.

lines.t: The coach leaves at quarter to eight and it takes about forty minutes to get there.
lines.say: The coach leaves at quarter to eight and it takes about forty minutes to get there.

items.q: Journey time: ____ minutes

hint.ar: forty بالضغط في أولها = ٤٠؛ وquarter to eight وقت المغادرة لا مدة الرحلة.
hint.en: FORty, stressed at the start = 40; “quarter to eight” is the departure time, not the duration.

why.ar: المدة forty minutes = ٤٠. لا تخلط بين الوقت والمدة.
why.en: The duration is forty minutes. Don’t confuse the departure time with the duration.

lines.t: Please bring a photograph and some form of ID, like your passport.
lines.say: Please bring a photograph and some form of ID, like your passport.

items.q: Bring: a ____ and ID

why.ar: a photograph — اسم مفرد بعد a. وpassport مثال على ID لا الإجابة.
why.en: a photograph — a singular noun after “a”; passport is just an example of ID.

lines.t: Delivery is usually on Friday. Actually, because of the holiday, it’ll be Monday this week.
lines.say: Delivery is usually on Friday. Actually, because of the holiday, it’ll be Monday this week.

items.q: Delivery day this week: ____

hint.ar: «usually» عادةً، و«this week» هذا الأسبوع. السؤال عن أيهما؟
hint.en: “usually” vs “this week” — which does the question ask about?

why.ar: Actually تغيّر المعلومة: هذا الأسبوع الاثنين بسبب العطلة.
why.en: “Actually” changes the information: this week it’s Monday because of the holiday.

lines.t: The total comes to twenty-three pounds fifty.
lines.say: The total comes to twenty-three pounds fifty.

items.q: Total: £____

hint.ar: اكتب السعر بالأرقام مع النقطة العشرية.
hint.en: Write the price in digits with a decimal point.

why.ar: twenty-three pounds fifty = 23.50.
why.en: twenty-three pounds fifty = 23.50.

lines.t: My email is j dot okafor at mailbox dot com. That’s O, K, A, F, O, R.
lines.say: My email is J dot Okafor at mailbox dot com. That’s O, K, A, F, O, R.

items.q: Email: j.____@mailbox.com

hint.ar: dot = نقطة، at = @. ركّز على التهجئة.
hint.en: dot = “.”, at = “@”. Focus on the spelling.

why.ar: O-K-A-F-O-R.
why.en: O-K-A-F-O-R.

lines.t: Parking is free for the first two hours, then it’s a pound an hour.
lines.say: Parking is free for the first two hours, then it’s a pound an hour.

items.q: Parking cost for the first 2 hours: ____

hint.ar: ما الذي يحدث في الساعتين الأوليين تحديدًا؟
hint.en: What happens in the first two hours exactly?

why.ar: الساعتان الأوليان مجانيتان؛ الجنيه بعد ذلك.
why.en: The first two hours are free; the pound applies after that.

lines.t: We thought about going by train, but it was too expensive, so we’re taking the coach.

items.q: How will they travel?

hint.ar: ابحث عن القرار النهائي بعد but وso.
hint.en: Find the final decision after “but” and “so”.

why.ar: القطار رُفض (too expensive)، والقرار بعد so: الحافلة.
why.en: The train is rejected (too expensive); the decision after “so” is the coach.

lines.t: The library used to open at nine, but since January it opens at eight.

items.q: When does the library open now?

hint.ar: used to = الماضي. السؤال عن now.
hint.en: “used to” = the past; the question asks about now.

why.ar: since January it opens at eight = الآن الثامنة.
why.en: “since January it opens at eight” = now 8 am.

lines.t: Everyone assumes the main problem is the cost, but actually most students told us it was the lack of time.

items.q: What was the main problem for students?

why.ar: «Everyone assumes» رأي شائع خاطئ؛ بعد but actually تأتي الحقيقة: الوقت.
why.en: “Everyone assumes” is the wrong common view; after “but actually” comes the truth: time.

lines.t: I’d like to start with the history section.
Hmm, I think the results are more interesting. Let’s open with those.
Fair enough, you’re right.

items.q: What will the students start their presentation with?

hint.ar: من وافق على اقتراح مَن في النهاية؟
hint.en: Who agreed to whose suggestion in the end?

why.ar: اقترح الطالب التاريخ، ثم وافق على اقتراح زميلته (Fair enough, you’re right): النتائج.
why.en: He suggested history, then agreed with her (Fair enough, you’re right): the results.

lines.t: Willow Cottage is fully booked that week, I’m afraid, but Rose Cottage is available, and it’s a bit cheaper.

items.q: Which cottage can the caller book?

why.ar: Willow محجوز بالكامل؛ المتاح Rose.
why.en: Willow is fully booked; Rose is available.

lines.t: The museum’s famous for its paintings, of course, but what really surprises visitors is the collection of old clocks.

items.q: What surprises visitors most?

hint.ar: «of course… but what really…» تفصل بين المتوقع والمفاجئ.
hint.en: “of course… but what really…” separates the expected from the surprising.

why.ar: اللوحات معروفة (of course)، أما المفاجئ فالساعات القديمة.
why.en: The paintings are expected (“of course”); the surprise is the old clocks.

lines.t: Originally the festival was held in the town hall. Then it moved to the park for a few years, and now it takes place in the old railway warehouse.

items.q: Where is the festival held now?

hint.ar: رتّب الأماكن زمنيًا: originally ← then ← now.
hint.en: Order the places in time: originally → then → now.

why.ar: now = المستودع القديم. old railway warehouse = a former warehouse (إعادة صياغة).
why.en: Now = the old railway warehouse, paraphrased as “a former warehouse”.

lines.t: Personally I’d put the survey online.
Our tutor thinks paper is better because more people actually fill it in.
Well, she knows best. Paper it is.

items.q: What did the tutor recommend?

hint.ar: السؤال عن رأي المشرفة، لا الطالبة.
hint.en: The question asks about the tutor’s view, not the student’s.

why.ar: الطالبة فضّلت الإنترنت، لكن المشرفة (Our tutor) رأت الورق أفضل.
why.en: The student preferred online, but the tutor thought paper was better.

lines.t: We could ask the council for funding, or try a crowdfunding page. The council takes months though, so let’s go with crowdfunding and maybe approach local businesses later.

items.q: How will they raise money first?

hint.en: Three options — which one comes first?

why.ar: المجلس مرفوض (takes months)، والشركات «later»، فالأول هو crowdfunding.
why.en: The council is rejected (takes months), businesses come “later”, so crowdfunding is first.

lines.t: It isn’t the price that puts people off. It’s really the distance from the city.

items.q: What puts people off?

hint.ar: انتبه للنفي: «It isn’t X, it’s Y».
hint.en: Watch the negative: “It isn’t X, it’s Y”.

why.ar: isn’t the price ← it’s the distance.
why.en: It isn’t the price → it’s the distance.

lines.t: When I started, I mostly did the cooking. These days I spend most of my time training new staff.

items.q: What is his main job now?

why.ar: الطبخ كان في البداية، والآن التدريب.
why.en: Cooking was at the start; now it’s training.

lines.t: My sister loved the beach, but I preferred the mountain walks, to be honest.

items.q: What did the speaker enjoy most?

hint.ar: السؤال عن المتحدثة نفسها لا أختها.
hint.en: The question is about the speaker, not her sister.

why.ar: الأخت أحبت الشاطئ، أما المتحدثة (I preferred) فالمشي في الجبال.
why.en: Her sister loved the beach; she preferred the mountain walks.

lines.t: Two benefits stood out: it saves time, and it cuts paper use. Some people said it’s cheaper, but that’s not really true.

items.q: Which TWO benefits are mentioned as real? (choose the pair)

hint.en: Which benefit did the speaker deny?

why.ar: «cheaper… not really true» مرفوضة، فالميزتان: توفير الوقت وتقليل الورق.
why.en: “cheaper… not really true” is rejected; the two are saving time and less paper.

lines.t: The new bus route looks convenient on paper. In practice, though, it adds about twenty minutes because of the extra stops.

items.q: What does the speaker say about the new route?

why.ar: in practice, though = الواقع: يضيف عشرين دقيقة، أي أطول.
why.en: “In practice, though” = it adds twenty minutes, so it takes longer.

lines.t: As you come in through the main entrance and walk straight ahead, the gift shop is the first room on your left.

items.q: Where is the gift shop?

hint.en: Imagine yourself entering and walking ahead.

why.ar: the first room on your left مباشرة.
why.en: Directly “the first room on your left”.

opts: at the end of the corridor

lines.t: The café is directly opposite the fountain, on the other side of the path.

items.q: Where is the café?

why.ar: directly opposite the fountain.
why.en: directly opposite the fountain.

lines.t: Walk north along the main path. The toilets are on your right, just past the playground.

items.q: If you walk north, the toilets are on the…

why.ar: الماشي شمالًا: اليمين شرق، واليسار غرب.
why.en: Walking north, right is east and left is west.

lines.t: The first-aid room is between the reception desk and the lifts.

items.q: Where is the first-aid room?

hint.en: between = with one thing on each side.

why.ar: between the reception desk and the lifts.
why.en: between the reception desk and the lifts.

lines.t: Now, walking back towards the gate from the lake, the picnic area is on your left.

items.q: The picnic area is on the left when walking towards the gate. If you walked FROM the gate to the lake, it would be on your…

hint.ar: عند عكس الاتجاه ينقلب اليمين واليسار.
hint.en: Reversing direction swaps left and right.

why.ar: يساري وأنا راجع إلى البوابة = يميني وأنا ذاهب إلى البحيرة.
why.en: Left when walking back to the gate = right when walking to the lake.

lines.t: At the end of the corridor, turn right, and the lecture theatre is the large room in the corner.

items.q: Where is the lecture theatre?

hint.ar: تتبّع الحركة خطوة بخطوة: end ← right ← corner.
hint.en: Track step by step: end → right → corner.

why.ar: نهاية الممر ثم يمينًا، والقاعة في الزاوية.
why.en: End of the corridor, turn right, the room in the corner.

opts: at the end of the corridor on the left
in the corner after turning right

lines.t: The car park isn’t the one you can see by the entrance — that’s for staff. Visitors park behind the main building.

items.q: Where do visitors park?

hint.ar: «isn’t the one… that’s for staff» = مرفوض.
hint.en: “isn’t the one… that’s for staff” = rejected.

why.ar: الموقف عند المدخل للموظفين، والزوار خلف المبنى.
why.en: The one by the entrance is for staff; visitors park behind the main building.

lines.t: Just before you reach the bridge, there’s a narrow path on your left that leads down to the boathouse.

items.q: How do you get to the boathouse?

why.ar: قبل الجسر مباشرة، ممر على اليسار.
why.en: Just before the bridge, a path on the left.

opts: cross the bridge and turn left
take the path on the left before the bridge
take the path on the right after the bridge

lines.t: So that covers the causes. Moving on to the effects, the most serious is the loss of farmland.

items.q: Which heading does the lecturer start now?

hint.en: “Moving on to…” announces the next heading.

why.ar: انتهت الأسباب (that covers the causes)، والآن الآثار.
why.en: The causes are finished; now the effects.

lines.t: Early boats were made from natural materials — mostly wood, but also animal skins.

items.q: Early boats were made from natural ____ (e.g. wood).

hint.ar: المثال wood مكتوب في الملاحظات؛ فما الفئة؟
hint.en: The example “wood” is already in the notes — so what is the category?

why.ar: natural materials هي الفئة، وwood مثال عليها.
why.en: “natural materials” is the category; wood is an example.

lines.t: The main advantage of the new material is that it’s extremely light, which makes transport much cheaper.

items.q: main advantage: very ____ (ONE WORD)

why.ar: extremely light ← very light. الصفة light.
why.en: extremely light → very light; the adjective is light.

lines.t: Another reason the city grew so quickly was its harbour, which attracted traders from across the region.

items.q: Second reason for the city’s growth: its ____

hint.ar: Another reason = السبب التالي في قائمتك.
hint.en: “Another reason” = the next reason in your notes.

why.ar: السبب الثاني: الميناء (harbour).
why.en: The second reason: its harbour.

lines.t: The insects feed mainly on nectar, although some species also eat pollen.

items.q: Main food: ____ (ONE WORD)

hint.ar: mainly = الأساسي، والـ some species استثناء.
hint.en: “mainly” = the main one; “some species” is the exception.

why.ar: الغذاء الرئيسي nectar، وpollen لبعض الأنواع فقط.
why.en: The main food is nectar; pollen is only for some species.

lines.t: Bees communicate the location of food through a kind of dance.

items.q: Bees show where food is by a ____

why.ar: a kind of dance ← a dance.
why.en: a kind of dance → a dance.

lines.t: To sum up, then, the evidence suggests the decline was caused not by climate, but by over-hunting.

items.q: Main cause of the decline: over-____

hint.ar: «not by X, but by Y» — أيهما السبب؟
hint.en: “not by X, but by Y” — which is the cause?

why.ar: المناخ مرفوض، والسبب الصيد الجائر (over-hunting).
why.en: Climate is rejected; the cause is over-hunting.

lines.t: The bricks were dried in the sun for about three weeks before use.

items.q: Bricks were dried for about ____ weeks

why.ar: about three weeks.
why.en: about three weeks.

items.src: The museum opens every day except Monday, from 10 am to 5 pm.
items.q: The museum is closed on Mondays.

hint.ar: هل يقول النص الشيء نفسه بكلمات أخرى؟
hint.en: Does the text say the same thing in other words?

why.ar: «every day except Monday» = مغلق الاثنين. إعادة صياغة دقيقة.
why.en: “every day except Monday” = closed on Mondays: an exact paraphrase.

items.src: The museum opens every day except Monday, from 10 am to 5 pm.
items.q: The museum is busiest at weekends.

hint.ar: هل يذكر النص أي شيء عن الازدحام؟
hint.en: Does the text mention how busy it is at all?

why.ar: النص يذكر الأوقات فقط، لا الازدحام. العبارة تضيف معلومة غير موجودة.
why.en: The text gives opening times only, nothing about crowds: an added detail.

items.src: Some researchers believe that the drug could help patients with memory loss.
items.q: All researchers agree the drug helps memory loss.

hint.ar: قارن some بـ all، وcould بـ helps.

why.ar: some researchers believe ≠ all researchers agree. يوجد تناقض صريح في الكلمة القوية all.
why.en: “some researchers believe” contradicts “all researchers agree”.

items.src: According to some accounts, the tower was built by a local merchant in the 1500s.
items.q: Historians are certain who built the tower.

hint.ar: «according to some accounts» تعني مؤكد أم غير مؤكد؟
hint.en: Does “according to some accounts” mean certain or uncertain?

why.ar: عبارة «بعض الروايات» تدل على عدم اليقين، وهذا يناقض certain.
why.en: “some accounts” signals uncertainty, contradicting “certain”.

items.src: The new bridge reduced journey times between the two towns by about twenty minutes.
items.q: The bridge was built because of complaints from drivers.

hint.ar: هل يذكر النص سبب بناء الجسر؟
hint.en: Does the text give the reason the bridge was built?

why.ar: النص يذكر النتيجة (تقليل الوقت) لا السبب. العبارة تضيف سببًا ← NOT GIVEN.
why.en: The text gives the result, not the reason; the statement adds a cause → NOT GIVEN.

items.src: Unlike most birds, the kiwi cannot fly.
items.q: The kiwi is able to fly short distances.

why.ar: cannot fly يناقض able to fly. الدليل المعاكس موجود.
why.en: “cannot fly” contradicts “able to fly”.

items.src: Sales fell in the first quarter but recovered strongly by the end of the year.
items.q: Sales were higher at the end of the year than at the start.

hint.ar: «recovered» تعني عادت للارتفاع، لكن هل تعني أنها تجاوزت مستوى البداية؟
hint.en: “recovered” means rose again — but did they pass the starting level?

why.ar: النص يقول إنها تعافت بقوة، ولا يقارن نهاية السنة ببدايتها صراحة. لا يمكن الحكم.
why.en: The text says sales recovered strongly but never compares end-of-year with start-of-year.

items.src: Most of the island’s electricity comes from wind power.
items.q: Wind is the main source of electricity on the island.

why.ar: Most of … comes from wind = الرياح المصدر الرئيسي.
why.en: “Most… comes from wind” = wind is the main source.

items.src: The team tested the material in a laboratory at temperatures of up to 200°C.
items.q: The material failed when heated above 200°C.

hint.ar: هل يقول النص ماذا حدث فوق ٢٠٠؟
hint.en: Does the text say what happened above 200?

why.ar: النص يذكر حدود الاختبار فقط، لا نتيجة ما فوقها.
why.en: The text gives the test limit only, not what happens above it.

items.src: It is thought that the paintings were made around 8,000 years ago, although some experts suggest an earlier date.
items.q: Experts agree on the age of the paintings.

hint.ar: هل يوجد اختلاف بين الخبراء في النص؟
hint.en: Do the experts disagree in the text?

why.ar: «some experts suggest an earlier date» تعني اختلافًا، وهذا يناقض agree.
why.en: “some experts suggest an earlier date” means disagreement, contradicting “agree”.

items.src: The festival, first held in 1998, now attracts over 50,000 visitors a year.
items.q: The festival began in the 1990s.

why.ar: 1998 ضمن التسعينيات (the 1990s).
why.en: 1998 is in the 1990s.

items.src: Volunteers planted more than 3,000 trees along the river last spring.
items.q: The trees were paid for by the local council.

hint.ar: من موّل الأشجار؟ هل يذكر النص ذلك؟
hint.en: Who paid? Does the text say?

why.ar: النص يذكر المتطوعين والعدد فقط، لا التمويل.
why.en: The text mentions volunteers and the number only, not funding.

items.src: The species is found only in the mountains of the north.
items.q: The species can be seen in several regions of the country.

why.ar: found only in the north يناقض several regions.
why.en: “found only in the north” contradicts “several regions”.

items.src: The writer argues that cities should invest in public transport rather than build more roads.
items.q: The writer prefers road building to public transport.

hint.ar: هذا عن رأي الكاتب: ماذا يفضّل؟
hint.en: This is about the writer’s view: what does he prefer?

why.ar: الكاتب يفضّل النقل العام (rather than roads)، فالعبارة تناقض رأيه ← NO.
why.en: The writer prefers public transport (rather than roads); the statement contradicts his view → NO.

items.src: In my view, the benefits of homework for young children have been greatly exaggerated.
items.q: Homework is more useful for teenagers than for young children.

hint.en: Does the writer compare with teenagers?

why.ar: الكاتب يتحدث عن الأطفال الصغار فقط ولا يقارن بالمراهقين.
why.en: The writer only discusses young children; no comparison with teenagers.

items.src: Critics say the policy is too expensive, but I believe its long-term savings will more than justify the cost.
items.q: The writer thinks the policy is worth its cost.

hint.en: What does the writer believe (I believe)?

why.ar: «savings will more than justify the cost» = تستحق التكلفة ← YES. رأي النقاد ليس رأي الكاتب.
why.en: “savings will more than justify the cost” = worth it → YES. The critics’ view isn’t the writer’s.

items.src: There is little evidence that brain-training games improve general intelligence.
items.q: Brain-training games have been proven to raise intelligence.

hint.ar: little evidence تعني دليلًا قويًا أم ضعيفًا؟
hint.en: Does “little evidence” mean strong or weak evidence?

why.ar: little evidence = دليل ضعيف، وهذا يناقض proven.
why.en: “little evidence” contradicts “proven”.

items.src: The library has more than 2 million books, including a rare collection of maps.
items.q: The library’s maps are kept in a special room.

hint.ar: هل يذكر النص مكان حفظ الخرائط؟
hint.en: Does the text say where the maps are kept?

why.ar: النص يذكر وجود الخرائط لا مكانها.
why.en: The text mentions the maps, not where they are kept.

items.src: Although the factory closed in 1985, the building was later converted into apartments.
items.q: The factory building is still used for manufacturing.

hint.en: What happened to the building after closing?

why.ar: المصنع أُغلق وتحول إلى شقق، فلا يُستخدم للتصنيع.
why.en: The factory closed and became apartments, so it isn’t used for manufacturing.

items.src: The method was first developed in Japan in the 1960s.
items.q: Japan was the first country to use the method.

hint.ar: first developed in Japan = أول من استخدمه؟
hint.en: Does “first developed in Japan” = Japan was first?

why.ar: first developed in Japan تعني أنه ظهر أولًا في اليابان.
why.en: “first developed in Japan” means it appeared there first.

items.src:
A  Most desert plants are small.
B  The roots of one acacia were found 30 metres below the surface.
C  Leaves lose water through tiny pores.
items.q: Which paragraph contains a specific measurement?

hint.ar: ابحث عن رقم مع وحدة قياس.
hint.en: Look for a number with a unit.

why.ar: 30 metres قياس محدد في الفقرة B.
why.en: “30 metres” is a specific measurement in B.

items.src:
A  The first lighthouses were simple fires.
B  In the 1820s, Augustin Fresnel designed a new lens.
C  Keepers lived in the towers for weeks.
items.q: Which paragraph mentions an inventor?

hint.en: A person’s name is a fast anchor.

why.ar: Augustin Fresnel صمّم عدسة = مخترع.
why.en: Augustin Fresnel designed a lens = an inventor.

items.src:
A  Coral reefs protect coasts from storms.
B  Rising temperatures cause corals to expel algae, because the heat stresses them.
C  Divers attach fragments to reefs.
items.q: Which paragraph explains why something happens?

why.ar: B تشرح السبب: because the heat stresses them.
why.en: B explains a cause: because the heat stresses them.

items.src:
A  Paper bags have been used since the 1850s.
B  Unlike plastic, paper breaks down quickly in water.
C  Many shops now charge for bags.
items.q: Which paragraph contains a contrast between two materials?

hint.ar: Unlike / whereas / in contrast إشارات المقارنة.
hint.en: Unlike / whereas / in contrast signal a contrast.

why.ar: «Unlike plastic, paper…» مقارنة بين مادتين.
why.en: “Unlike plastic, paper…” contrasts two materials.

items.src: Dr Lena Hart found that sleep improves memory. Professor Ito, however, argued that the effect is small. A third researcher, Dr Mills, studied only children.
items.q: Who doubted the size of the effect?

hint.ar: ابحث عن however بعد اسم الشخص.

why.ar: Ito argued the effect is small = شكّك في حجم الأثر.
why.en: Ito argued the effect is small = he doubted its size.

items.src:
A  The town grew around its harbour.
B  For example, traders from Venice brought glass and spices.
C  Today the harbour is used mainly by tourists.
items.q: Which paragraph gives an example of foreign trade?

why.ar: B: For example, traders from Venice.
why.en: B: For example, traders from Venice.

items.src: The bridge, completed in 1932, was the longest of its kind for nearly forty years.
items.q: When was the bridge finished?

hint.en: The date is an anchor; completed = finished.

why.ar: completed in 1932.
why.en: completed in 1932.

items.src:
A  Scientists measured the noise in 40 parks.
B  Birds in noisy parks sang at a higher pitch.
C  This suggests birds adapt their songs to be heard.
items.q: Which paragraph contains a conclusion drawn from research?

why.ar: C تستنتج من النتيجة: This suggests…
why.en: C draws a conclusion: This suggests…

items.src: Desalination plants turn seawater into drinking water. But the process uses huge amounts of energy, and the salty waste returned to the sea can harm marine life.
items.q: Best heading?

hint.en: What is most of the paragraph about?

why.ar: الجملة الأولى تمهيد، وأغلب الفقرة عن العيوب (energy, waste) بعد But.
why.en: The first sentence is background; after “But” the paragraph is about drawbacks.

items.src: To reduce traffic, the city introduced a congestion charge, extended bus lanes and opened three new metro lines.
items.q: Best heading?

hint.ar: هل الفقرة تعرض مشكلة أم حلولًا؟

why.ar: ثلاث إجراءات لتقليل الازدحام = حلول (measures).
why.en: Three actions to reduce traffic = measures (solutions).

items.src: Early umbrellas were status symbols. In many ancient societies, only kings and nobles were shaded by them, and their size showed how important the owner was.
items.q: Best heading?

hint.ar: احذر العنوان الذي يطابق كلمة واحدة (size, kings).
hint.en: Beware headings matching a single word (size, kings).

why.ar: الفكرة الرئيسية: المظلة رمز للمكانة. size وkings تفاصيل.
why.en: The main idea: umbrellas as status symbols; size and kings are details.

items.src: Some critics argue that the scheme has failed. Yet the figures tell a different story: accidents have fallen by a third since it began.
items.q: Best heading?

hint.ar: Yet تقلب الاتجاه: الفقرة تنتهي بماذا؟
hint.en: “Yet” turns the paragraph: where does it end up?

why.ar: الفقرة تعرض رأي النقاد ثم ترد عليه بالأرقام.
why.en: It presents the critics’ view, then answers it with figures.

items.src: Researchers now know that the gut contains trillions of bacteria. These microbes help digest food, produce vitamins and even influence our mood.
items.q: Best heading?

hint.ar: لخّص بكلماتك: البكتيريا تفعل أشياء كثيرة.

why.ar: الفقرة تعدد وظائف البكتيريا.
why.en: The paragraph lists the bacteria’s functions.

opts: The many roles of gut bacteria

items.src: Although the octopus has a large brain, two-thirds of its neurons are in its arms, which can act almost independently.
items.q: Best heading?

hint.en: What is surprising in the paragraph?

why.ar: الفكرة: معظم الخلايا العصبية في الأذرع. حجم الدماغ تفصيل يأتي بعد Although.
why.en: The point: most neurons are in the arms; brain size is a detail after “Although”.

opts: An unusual distribution of nerve cells
The size of the octopus brain

items.src: A large cactus can hold several hundred litres of water after a storm.
items.q: After a storm, a large cactus may store several hundred ____ of water.

hint.ar: بعد several hundred اسم جمع لوحدة قياس.

why.ar: several hundred litres of water — وحدة القياس من النص.
why.en: several hundred litres of water — the unit from the text.

items.src: Lighting is usually the largest single cost, followed by air-conditioning.
items.q: The second biggest cost is ____.

why.ar: الإضاءة الأولى ثم air-conditioning.
why.en: Lighting first, then air-conditioning.

items.src: This explains why cacti grow so slowly.
items.q: Cacti grow very ____.

hint.ar: بعد grow نحتاج ظرفًا لا صفة.
hint.en: After “grow” we need an adverb, not an adjective.

why.ar: slowly (ظرف) لا slow.
why.en: slowly (adverb), not slow.

items.src: The blocks were cut on land and then fitted together like a puzzle.
items.q: The blocks were prepared on ____ before being assembled.

why.ar: cut on land = prepared on land.
why.en: cut on land = prepared on land.

items.src: Each fragment must be handled individually by a diver.
items.q: Divers have to treat each ____ separately.

why.ar: each fragment — مفرد كما في النص.
why.en: each fragment — singular, as in the text.

items.src: Sunlight comes from above, so the underside of an animal is normally in shadow.
items.q: Countershading removes the effect of ____. (ONE WORD)

why.ar: the effect of shadow.
why.en: the effect of shadow.

items.src: Many students decide not to apply because they fear years of debt.
items.q: High fees discourage students because they are afraid of ____.

hint.en: afraid of = fear; a noun follows.

why.ar: fear years of debt ← afraid of debt.
why.en: fear years of debt → afraid of debt.

items.src: Some newer farms are being built next to sources of cheap renewable energy.
items.q: New farms are located near cheap ____ energy.

hint.ar: بين cheap وenergy صفة من النص.
hint.en: Between “cheap” and “energy”, an adjective from the text.

why.ar: cheap renewable energy.
why.en: cheap renewable energy.

items.src: The colour of desert plants tends to be pale grey or silver, which reduces the heat they absorb.
items.q: Pale colours mean that less ____ is absorbed.

why.ar: less heat.
why.en: less heat.

items.src: The festival has a new main venue: a restored railway warehouse.
items.q: The main concerts will take place in a former railway ____.

why.ar: railway warehouse.
why.en: railway warehouse.

items.src: The scheme was abandoned after two years.
items.q: Which word in the question would match “abandoned”?

why.ar: abandoned = dropped.
why.en: abandoned = dropped.

items.src: Mobile phones are discouraged in the library.
items.q: Which statement matches?

hint.ar: discouraged أقوى أم أضعف من banned؟

why.ar: discouraged = غير مستحسن، لا ممنوع.
why.en: discouraged = not recommended, not banned.

opts: Phones are banned in the library.
Phones are not recommended in the library.
Phones are sold in the library.

items.src: The town’s population has roughly doubled since 1980.
items.q: Which matches?

why.ar: roughly doubled = about twice as many.
why.en: roughly doubled = about twice as many.

opts: There are about twice as many residents now.

items.src: The equipment is now obsolete.
items.q: Which matches?

why.ar: obsolete = قديم لم يعد مستخدمًا (out of date)، وليس معطلًا.
why.en: obsolete = out of date, not broken.

opts: The equipment is out of date.

items.src: Admission is free for under-fives.
items.q: Which matches?

why.ar: free for under-fives = young children don’t pay.
why.en: free for under-fives = young children don’t pay.

opts: Young children don’t have to pay.

items.src: The results were broadly similar across all age groups.
items.q: Which matches?

hint.ar: similar across groups = لا فرق كبير.

why.ar: broadly similar = little difference.
why.en: broadly similar = little difference.

opts: Age made little difference to the results.
Only one age group was tested.

items.src: Line graph: Car use 2000→2020 rose from 40% to 70%; bus use fell from 35% to 15%; cycling stayed at about 5%.
items.q: Which is the best overview?

hint.ar: النظرة العامة: اتجاهات رئيسية بلا أرقام ولا رأي.
hint.en: An overview: main trends, no numbers, no opinion.

why.ar: B تلخص الاتجاهات الثلاثة بلا أرقام. A تفصيل، وC رأي غير مسموح.
why.en: B summarises the three trends without numbers. A is a detail; C is an opinion.

opts: Overall, car use increased significantly while bus use declined, and cycling changed little.
Cars are bad for the environment, so people should cycle.

items.src: Data: Sales went from 200 to 205 units.
items.q: Which phrase describes this change best?

hint.ar: الفرق ٥ وحدات فقط من ٢٠٠: كبير أم صغير؟
hint.en: A change of 5 from 200: big or small?

why.ar: زيادة صغيرة جدًا = increased slightly.
why.en: A very small rise = increased slightly.

items.src: Data: Prices were 50 in 2010, 50 in 2012 and 51 in 2014.
items.q: Which phrase fits?

why.ar: شبه ثابت = remained stable / levelled off.
why.en: Almost unchanged = remained stable.

items.q: What happened in 2016?

why.ar: أعلى قيمة = peaked at.
why.en: The highest value = peaked at.

items.src: Table of 8 countries × 3 years.
items.q: What should the body paragraphs contain?

why.ar: اختر الأبرز وقارن؛ سرد كل رقم يخفض الدرجة، والأسباب غير مسموحة.
why.en: Select and compare; listing every number lowers the band, and reasons aren’t allowed.

opts: the key features with selected figures and comparisons

items.src: Pie charts: Energy 1990: coal 60%, gas 30%, renewables 10%. 2020: coal 25%, gas 35%, renewables 40%.
items.q: Which is the most important feature for the overview?

hint.ar: ما أكبر تغيير في الصورة كلها؟
hint.en: What is the biggest change in the whole picture?

why.ar: التحول من الفحم إلى المتجددة هو الملمح الأبرز.
why.en: The shift from coal to renewables is the key feature.

opts: Renewables replaced coal as the largest source.

items.src: Data: Unemployment fell from 12% to 4% in two years.
items.q: Choose the best verb + adverb.

hint.ar: من ١٢ إلى ٤ في سنتين: كبير وسريع.
hint.en: From 12 to 4 in two years: big and fast.

why.ar: هبوط كبير = dropped dramatically / fell sharply.
why.en: A big fall = dropped dramatically.

items.src: Line graph from 2000 to 2020.
items.q: Which tense should you use to describe it?

hint.en: The data is in the past.

why.ar: بيانات ماضية ← الماضي البسيط (rose, fell).
why.en: Past data → past simple (rose, fell).

items.src: Task: Write to your neighbour, whom you know well, to invite them to dinner.
items.q: Which closing is right?

hint.ar: جارك صديق مقرب ← رسالة غير رسمية.
hint.en: A neighbour you know well → informal.

why.ar: غير رسمي ← Best wishes.
why.en: Informal → Best wishes.

items.src: Letter begins: Dear Sir or Madam,
items.q: Which closing must you use?

why.ar: Dear Sir or Madam ← Yours faithfully.
why.en: Dear Sir or Madam → Yours faithfully.

items.src: Process diagram: 8 stages from harvesting to delivery.
items.q: Which overview is best for a process?

hint.ar: في العمليات: عدد المراحل + البداية + النهاية.
hint.en: For processes: number of stages + start + end.

why.ar: B نظرة عامة مثالية للعملية؛ A أول خطوة لا خلاصة، وC رأي.
why.en: B is the ideal process overview; A is the first step; C is an opinion.

opts: Overall, there are eight stages, beginning with harvesting and ending with delivery to shops.

items.src: Data: The figure was 20% in 2000 and 40% in 2010.
items.q: Which sentence is accurate?

why.ar: من ٢٠ إلى ٤٠ تضاعف (doubled). «rose by 40%» خطأ رياضي؛ الزيادة ٢٠ نقطة.
why.en: 20 → 40 doubled. “rose by 40%” is wrong; it rose by 20 points.

opts: The figure doubled over the decade.

items.src: Some people believe that children should start school at the age of four. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.q: What type of question is this?

hint.ar: To what extent do you agree…
hint.en: To what extent do you agree…

why.ar: To what extent do you agree = سؤال رأي يتطلب موقفًا واضحًا.
why.en: To what extent do you agree = an opinion question needing a clear position.

items.src: Many cities suffer from air pollution. What are the causes, and what can be done to solve this problem?
items.q: What type of question is this?

why.ar: أسباب + حلول = مشكلة وحل.
why.en: Causes + solutions = problem/solution.

items.src: Some say tourism benefits local communities; others say it harms them. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.q: How many things must you do?

why.ar: رأي أول + رأي ثانٍ + رأيك = ثلاثة أشياء.
why.en: View 1 + view 2 + your opinion = three things.

opts: three: discuss view 1, view 2, and give your opinion

items.src: Prompt: Should governments tax sugary drinks?
items.q: Which is the best thesis?

why.ar: B موقف واضح مع سببين. A غامضة، وC حقيقة لا موقف.
why.en: B is a clear position with reasons. A is vague; C is a fact, not a position.

opts: There are many opinions about this topic.
I believe taxing sugary drinks is justified because it reduces consumption and funds healthcare.

items.src: Point: Remote work saves time. Explain: no commuting. Example: ____
items.q: Which is the best example?

hint.en: A specific example beats a general one.

why.ar: B مثال محدد يدعم الفكرة؛ A وC عامّتان.
why.en: B is specific and supports the point; A and C are general.

opts: An employee who used to spend two hours a day in Riyadh traffic can use that time to rest or study.

items.src: Nowadays many people live alone. Why is this happening? Is it a positive or negative development?
items.q: What is the most common mistake with this question?

hint.en: How many questions are in the task?

why.ar: سؤالان: لماذا؟ وهل هو إيجابي؟ إهمال أحدهما يخفض إنجاز المهمة.
why.en: Two questions: why? and positive or negative? Ignoring one lowers Task Response.

opts: answering only one of the two questions

items.src: Do the advantages of online shopping outweigh the disadvantages?
items.q: Which thesis answers the question correctly?

why.ar: B تعطي حكمًا واضحًا؛ A تصف فقط دون حكم.
why.en: B gives a clear verdict; A only describes.

opts: Online shopping has advantages and disadvantages.
In my view, the advantages of online shopping clearly outweigh its drawbacks.

items.src: Body paragraph structure
items.q: What should the first sentence of a body paragraph be?

why.ar: الجملة الأولى = جملة الموضوع التي تحمل الفكرة.
why.en: The first sentence = the topic sentence with the main idea.

opts: a topic sentence stating the main idea

items.src: The life in big cities is stressful.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: الاسم العام بلا the: Life in big cities…
why.en: A general noun takes no “the”: Life in big cities…

a: Life in big cities is stressful.

items.src: This solution very effective.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: أضف is: This solution is very effective.
why.en: Add “is”: This solution is very effective.

items.src: Many people is worried about prices.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: people جمع ← are.
why.en: “people” is plural → are.

a: Many people are worried about prices.

items.src: The number of students have increased.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: the number (مفرد) ← has.
why.en: “the number” (singular) → has.

a: The number of students has increased.

items.src: We need more informations about the course.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: information غير معدودة: بلا s.
why.en: “information” is uncountable: no -s.

a: We need more information about the course.

items.src: It depends of the weather.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: depend on.
why.en: depend on.

items.src: Despite it was expensive, they bought it.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

hint.ar: despite لا تأتي بعدها جملة كاملة.
hint.en: “despite” isn’t followed by a full clause.

why.ar: Although + جملة، أو Despite + اسم/‑ing.
why.en: Although + clause, or Despite + noun/-ing.

a: Although it was expensive, they bought it.
Despite the high price, they bought it.
Despite its high price, they bought it.
Despite being expensive, they bought it.

items.src: The city is crowded, many people moved there for work.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

hint.en: Two full sentences joined only by a comma.

why.ar: استخدم because أو نقطة.
why.en: Use “because” or a full stop.

a: The city is crowded because many people moved there for work.
The city is crowded. Many people moved there for work.
The city is crowded because many people have moved there for work.

items.src: This is the book which I bought it yesterday.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: احذف it.
why.en: Delete “it”.

a: This is the book which I bought yesterday.
This is the book that I bought yesterday.
This is the book I bought yesterday.

items.src: In 2010, the price rise to £5.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: rise ← rose (ماضٍ).
why.en: rise → rose (past).

items.src: He is very interested about history.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: interested in.
why.en: interested in.

a: He is very interested in history.

items.src: There are many advantage of studying abroad.
items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: advantage ← advantages.
why.en: advantage → advantages.

a: There are many advantages of studying abroad.
There are many advantages to studying abroad.

items.src: Public transport is cheap. ____, it reduces pollution.
items.q: Choose the linker.

why.ar: ميزة + ميزة = Moreover.
why.en: Benefit + benefit = Moreover.

items.src: Cars are convenient. ____, they cause traffic jams.
items.q: Choose the linker.

hint.en: Relationship: an advantage then a drawback.

why.ar: تضاد = However.
why.en: Contrast = However.

items.src: Fees have risen sharply. ____, fewer students are applying.
items.q: Choose the linker.

hint.en: Is the second sentence a result of the first?

why.ar: نتيجة = As a result.
why.en: Result = As a result.

items.src: Many jobs can be done online. ____, software developers often work from home.
items.q: Choose the linker.

hint.ar: الجملة الثانية حالة خاصة من الأولى.
hint.en: The second sentence is a specific case of the first.

why.ar: مثال = For example.
why.en: Example = For example.

items.src: Some argue that zoos protect species, ____ others see them as cruel.
items.q: Choose the linker.

hint.ar: مقارنة بين رأيين داخل جملة واحدة.
hint.en: Contrasting two views inside one sentence.

why.ar: whereas تربط رأيين متضادين في جملة واحدة.
why.en: “whereas” links two contrasting views in one sentence.

items.src: Smartphones distract students. ____, they can be useful learning tools.
items.q: Choose the linker.

hint.en: A drawback, then a benefit despite it.

why.ar: Nevertheless = ومع ذلك (تضاد).
why.en: Nevertheless = despite that (contrast).

items.src: Cars are expensive. Many people use buses. Buses are cheap.
items.q: Which version has the best cohesion?

hint.ar: أيها يربط بلا تكرار ولا فواصل خاطئة؟
hint.en: Which links ideas without repetition or comma errors?

why.ar: B تربط السبب بـ Because وتشير بـ which دون تكرار.
why.en: B links the cause with “Because” and refers back with “which”.

opts: Cars are expensive. And many people use buses. And buses are cheap.
Because cars are expensive, many people use buses, which are much cheaper.
Cars are expensive, many people use buses, buses are cheap.

items.src: Examiner: Do you like cooking?
items.q: Which answer is best for Part 1?

why.ar: B تجيب وتعطي سببًا وتفصيلًا. A قصيرة جدًا، وC تعريف لا إجابة شخصية.
why.en: B answers with a reason and detail. A is too short; C is a definition.

opts: Yes, I do, especially at weekends. I usually make traditional dishes like kabsa because they remind me of my grandmother.
Cooking is the preparation of food using heat.

items.src: Examiner: What do you do in your free time?
items.q: Which opener sounds most natural?

why.ar: «It depends…» بداية طبيعية تفتح لتفاصيل.
why.en: “It depends…” is a natural opener that leads to details.

opts: It depends on how much time I have, really.
My free time activities are as follows.
Free time is important for everyone.

items.src: Examiner: Has your hometown changed much?
items.q: Which tense is most useful here?

hint.ar: السؤال عن تغيّر من الماضي إلى الآن.
hint.en: The question is about change up to now.

why.ar: التغير حتى الآن ← المضارع التام.
why.en: Change up to now → present perfect.

opts: present perfect (has changed, have been built)

items.src: Examiner: Would you like to live abroad?
items.q: Which phrase starts a good answer about the future?

why.ar: Ideally, I’d like to… = رغبة مستقبلية بشكل طبيعي.
why.en: “Ideally, I’d like to…” expresses a future wish naturally.

items.src: Examiner: Do you prefer reading books or watching films?
items.q: Which answer best shows comparison?

why.ar: B تفضيل + سبب + مقارنة بـ whereas.
why.en: B gives a preference, a reason and a comparison with “whereas”.

opts: I prefer films because they’re more relaxing after a long day, whereas books need more concentration.
Books and films are both good.

items.src: Cue card: Describe a place you visited that you would like to go back to.
items.q: What should you write in your one minute of notes?

hint.en: Notes are reminders, not a script.

why.ar: الكلمات المفتاحية أسرع وتمنعك من القراءة الآلية.
why.en: Key words are faster and stop you reading a script.

opts: 6–8 key words such as: AlUla · winter · family · rocks · stars · more time

items.src: You can’t remember a word in the middle of your talk.
items.q: What is the best thing to do?

why.ar: أداة كسب وقت + وصف بكلمات أخرى = طلاقة محفوظة.
why.en: A time-buyer plus a paraphrase keeps your fluency.

opts: say “Let me think… what I mean is…” and describe it in other words

items.src: Cue card points: who · what · when · and explain why.
items.q: Which part should you spend the most time on?

hint.ar: أعمق نقطة تعطي فرصة للمفردات والقواعد.
hint.en: The deepest point gives the most chance for vocabulary and grammar.

why.ar: «explain why» تسمح بالتفصيل والأسباب، فأطِل فيها.
why.en: “explain why” allows reasons and detail — spend longest there.

items.src: You finish after 70 seconds.
items.q: What should you do?

why.ar: أضف ما تعلمته أو مشاعرك بدل التوقف أو التكرار.
why.en: Add what you learned or felt rather than stopping or repeating.

opts: add what you learned or how you felt, or whether you’d do it again

items.src: Examiner: Why do people like visiting historical places?
items.q: Which answer is best for Part 3?

hint.ar: الجزء الثالث عن الناس عمومًا، مع رأي وسبب وتفصيل.
hint.en: Part 3 is about people in general, with opinion, reason and detail.

why.ar: B رأي عام مشروح بأسباب. A شخصية وقصيرة، وC بلا رأي.
why.en: B is a general, explained opinion. A is personal and short; C has no opinion.

opts: I think people are curious about how others lived in the past. Visiting real sites makes history feel alive in a way books can’t, and for many it’s also about feeling connected to their roots.

items.src: Examiner: Will people read fewer books in the future?
items.q: Which phrase introduces a prediction well?

why.ar: It’s likely that… / I expect… للتوقع.
why.en: “It’s likely that…” / “I expect…” for predictions.

items.src: Examiner: Is it better to learn online or in a classroom?
items.q: Which answer shows balance and a clear view?

hint.en: A clear view + acknowledging the other side.

why.ar: B متوازنة وتنتهي برأي مدعوم.
why.en: B is balanced and ends with a supported view.

opts: It depends on the learner. Online suits working adults, but I’d say classrooms are better for young people because they need structure and interaction.

items.src: Examiner: How has shopping changed compared to the past?
items.q: Which structure is most useful?

why.ar: Compared to the past / whereas now تبني إجابة مقارنة واضحة.
why.en: “Compared to the past… whereas now…” builds a clear comparison.

opts: Compared to the past, … whereas now …

items.src: Examiner: Should the government pay for sports facilities?
items.q: Which example would strengthen your answer most?

hint.en: A specific example lifts the band.

why.ar: B مثال محلي محدد يدعم الحجة.
why.en: B is a specific local example supporting the argument.

opts: For example, the new public sports parks in Riyadh have encouraged many families to exercise.

items.q: Which room will the group use?

hint.en: Which options were rejected, and why?

why.ar: المكتبة مغلقة والغرفة ١٢ صغيرة، فاستقروا على القاعة.
why.en: The library is closed and Room 12 is too small, so they settle on the hall.

lines.t: The library’s closed on Saturdays, and Room twelve only holds ten people, so let’s book the main hall.

items.q: Why did the speaker choose this course?

hint.en: What does she call the real reason?

why.ar: السعر والتقييمات ذُكرا، لكن «what really decided it» هو الجدول.
why.en: Price and reviews are mentioned, but “what really decided it” was the timetable.

lines.t: It was quite cheap and the reviews were good, but what really decided it was that the classes fitted around my work.

items.q: How does the man travel to work now?

why.ar: كان يقود سابقًا، والآن بالدراجة منذ افتتاح المسار.
why.en: He used to drive; now he cycles since the lane opened.

lines.t: I used to drive, but since they opened the new cycle lane, I go by bike every day.

items.q: What does the TUTOR think the students should change?

hint.ar: ركّز على كلام المشرف لا الطالب.
hint.en: Focus on what the tutor says.

why.ar: الطالب قلق من العنوان، والمشرف قال إن الخاتمة تحتاج عملًا.
why.en: The student worries about the title; the tutor says the conclusion needs work.

lines.t: I’m worried the title is too long.
The title’s fine, actually. It’s the conclusion that needs more work.

items.q: Where is the information desk?

hint.ar: ابحث عن المعلم المرجعي في الجملة.
hint.en: Find the landmark in the sentence.

why.ar: right next to the lifts.
why.en: right next to the lifts.

lines.t: The information desk is right next to the lifts, so you can’t miss it.

items.q: Where is the garden?

why.ar: in the south-west corner.
why.en: in the south-west corner.

lines.t: The herb garden is tucked away in the south-west corner of the site.

items.q: Where is the exhibition room?

hint.ar: عُد الأبواب واهتم بالاتجاه بعد الالتفاف.
hint.en: Count doors and watch direction after turning.

why.ar: اتجه يسارًا عند نهاية الممر، ثم الباب الثاني على يمينك.
why.en: Turn left at the end, then the second door on your right.

lines.t: At the end of the hall, turn left. The exhibition room is the second door on your right.

opts: the second door on the right
the second door on the left
the first door on the right

items.q: Where is the new sports hall?

hint.ar: «where X used to be» = في نفس المكان.
hint.en: “where X used to be” = in the same place.

why.ar: الصالة بُنيت مكان الموقف القديم.
why.en: The hall was built where the old car park used to be.

lines.t: The new sports hall stands where the old car park used to be.

opts: where the old car park was
next to the old car park

items.q: The toilets are…

why.ar: at the top of the stairs.
why.en: at the top of the stairs.

lines.t: You’ll find the toilets at the top of the stairs, on the first floor.

opts: at the top of the stairs
at the bottom of the stairs

items.q: The lecturer is now talking about…

why.ar: On the downside = العيوب.
why.en: “On the downside” = disadvantages.

lines.t: So those are the benefits. On the downside, the material is very expensive to produce.

items.q: Most damage is caused by ____ (ONE WORD)

why.ar: insects هي الفئة، وbeetles مثال.
why.en: insects is the category; beetles is an example.

lines.t: Most of the damage is caused by insects, especially a type of beetle.

items.q: The walls were built from ____ (ONE WORD)

why.ar: made from mud mixed with straw — المادة الأساسية mud.
why.en: made from mud mixed with straw — the main material is mud.

lines.t: The walls were made from mud, mixed with straw to make them stronger.

items.q: What will the lecturer discuss next week?

why.ar: This week causes; next week solutions.
why.en: This week causes; next week solutions.

lines.t: Today we’ve looked at the causes. Next week, we’ll turn to possible solutions.

items.q: The fish can survive in water as cold as ____ degrees.

hint.en: Expect a number — watch for minus.

why.ar: minus two = -2.
why.en: minus two = -2.

lines.t: Remarkably, this fish survives in water as cold as minus two degrees.

items.q: Traders exchanged salt for ____ (ONE WORD)

why.ar: exchanged for gold.
why.en: exchanged for gold.

lines.t: In the markets, salt was exchanged for gold, sometimes at equal weight.

items.q: Course length: ____ weeks

hint.en: Expect a number; ignore the other one (two hours).

why.ar: ten weeks مدة الدورة، وtwo hours مدة الحصة.
why.en: Ten weeks is the course; two hours is each class.

lines.t: The course runs for ten weeks, with one two-hour class each week.

items.q: Company name: ____

why.ar: B-R-E-double N-O-C-K.
why.en: B-R-E-double N-O-C-K.

lines.t: It’s Brennock Logistics. B, R, E, double N, O, C, K.

items.q: The plant flowers every year.

hint.ar: once every twelve years مقابل every year.

why.ar: كل ١٢ سنة يناقض كل سنة.
why.en: Every twelve years contradicts every year.

items.src: The plant flowers only once every twelve years.

items.q: The company’s first shop was in the capital.

hint.en: Is the location of the first shop given?

why.ar: النص يذكر السنة والعدد فقط.
why.en: Only the year and number are given.

items.src: The company opened its first shop in 1990 and now has over 200 branches.

items.q: Music definitely improves concentration in all children.

why.ar: النص متحفظ وجزئي؛ العبارة مطلقة فتناقضه.
why.en: The text is tentative and partial; the absolute statement contradicts it.

items.src: The findings suggest that music may improve concentration in some children.

items.q: Visitors do not have to pay to enter the gallery.

why.ar: costs nothing = do not have to pay.
why.en: costs nothing = do not have to pay.

items.src: Entry to the gallery costs nothing, though donations are welcome.

items.q: None of the original buildings survive.

why.ar: few = عدد قليل موجود، وnone = لا شيء. تناقض.
why.en: “few” means some remain; “none” contradicts it.

items.src: Few of the original buildings survive today.

items.q: Most of the nurses interviewed were women.

why.ar: لا يذكر النص الجنس.
why.en: Gender isn’t mentioned.

items.src: The researchers interviewed 300 nurses across five hospitals.

items.q: The writer believes the scheme is worthwhile.

why.ar: far outweigh its costs = worthwhile ← YES.
why.en: “far outweigh its costs” = worthwhile → YES.

items.src: I would argue that the benefits of the scheme far outweigh its costs.

items.q: The writer thinks students learn less online.

hint.en: What is the writer’s own view?

why.ar: الكاتب لا يرى دليلًا على ذلك، فالعبارة تناقض رأيه.
why.en: The writer sees no evidence of this, so the statement contradicts him.

items.src: While some claim online learning is inferior, I see no evidence that students learn less online.

items.q: The novel won an international prize.

why.ar: الترجمة مذكورة، الجائزة لا.
why.en: Translation is mentioned; a prize isn’t.

items.src: The novel was translated into more than forty languages.

items.q: Everyone agrees on when the castle was built.

hint.ar: widely believed ≠ everyone agrees، لكن هل يذكر النص خلافًا؟
hint.en: “widely believed” isn’t “everyone agrees” — but is disagreement stated?

why.ar: النص لا يذكر اتفاقًا كاملًا ولا خلافًا صريحًا، فلا يمكن الحكم. (لو قال «some disagree» لكانت FALSE.)
why.en: The text states neither full agreement nor disagreement, so it can’t be decided.

items.src: It is widely believed that the castle was built in the 12th century.

items.q: How many passengers travelled on the first day?

hint.ar: الرقم مرساة؛ opening day = first day.
hint.en: The number is your anchor; opening day = first day.

why.ar: about 38,000 passengers on the opening day.
why.en: about 38,000 passengers on the opening day.

items.src: The first trains ran on the line in 1863, carrying about 38,000 passengers on the opening day.

items.q: Which paragraph mentions a problem experienced by visitors?

why.ar: B: visitors complain.
why.en: B: visitors complain.

items.src:
A  The museum has five floors.
B  Many visitors complain that the signs are confusing.
C  The café serves local food.

items.q: Who thought insects spread the disease?

why.ar: Dr Chen believed it was carried by insects.
why.en: Dr Chen believed it was carried by insects.

items.src: Dr Patel argued that the disease spread through water, while Dr Chen believed it was carried by insects.

items.q: Which paragraph contains a prediction?

hint.en: could / will / if… continue = a prediction.

why.ar: B: If… continue to fall, prices could rise.
why.en: B: If… continue to fall, prices could rise.

items.src:
A  Bees pollinate a third of our crops.
B  If bee numbers continue to fall, food prices could rise sharply.
C  Some farmers now keep their own hives.

items.q: How long did construction take?

hint.ar: took … to build = مدة البناء، لا الطول.
hint.en: “took… to build” = construction time, not length.

why.ar: eleven years؛ أما ٥٧ كم فهي الطول.
why.en: Eleven years; 57 km is the length.

items.src: The tunnel, which took eleven years to build, is 57 kilometres long.

items.q: Which paragraph describes a design improvement?

hint.en: Look for a new design described.

why.ar: B تصف دراجة الأمان بعجلتين متساويتين وسلسلة.
why.en: B describes the safety bicycle with equal wheels and a chain.

items.src:
A  Early bicycles were heavy and dangerous.
B  The ‘safety bicycle’ of the 1880s had two equal wheels and a chain.
C  Cycling clubs became popular.

items.q: Who led the study?

why.ar: led by Professor Amira Haddad.
why.en: led by Professor Amira Haddad.

items.src: The study was led by Professor Amira Haddad at a research centre in Jordan.

items.q: Best heading?

why.ar: انهيار الصيد وفقدان الوظائف = تراجع صناعة تقليدية.
why.en: Collapse of fishing and lost jobs = decline of a traditional industry.

items.src: In the 1950s, the town relied on fishing. When the fish stocks collapsed in the 1970s, hundreds of jobs disappeared and many families moved away.
opts: The decline of a traditional industry

items.q: Best heading?

why.ar: الفقرة تعدد أسباب النجاح.
why.en: The paragraph lists reasons for success.

items.src: Several factors explain the success of the scheme. It was cheap to run, easy to use, and supported by local businesses from the start.

items.q: Best heading?

why.ar: الفكرة: عمر البطارية القصير يحد الاستخدام. البطارية تفصيل يخدم «القيد».
why.en: The point is the short battery life limiting usefulness — a practical limitation.

items.src: The robot can climb stairs and open doors. However, its battery lasts only forty minutes, which severely limits its usefulness in real homes.

items.q: Best heading?

why.ar: مقارنة مجموعتين ونتيجة = تجربة.
why.en: Two groups compared with a result = an experiment.

items.src: Researchers compared two groups: one slept eight hours, the other five. The well-rested group remembered 40% more words.
opts: An experiment on sleep and memory

items.q: Best heading?

why.ar: المطحنة القديمة صار لها استخدامات جديدة = حياة جديدة لمبنى قديم.
why.en: The old mill has new uses = a new life for an old building.

items.src: Today the old mill houses a museum, a café and artists’ studios, attracting thousands of visitors each year.
opts: A new life for an old building

items.q: Best heading?

hint.ar: ماذا حدث للسيارات الكهربائية الأولى؟ ولماذا؟
hint.en: What happened to early electric cars, and why?

why.ar: الفقرة تشرح لماذا تفوقت سيارات البنزين = فشل السيارات الكهربائية المبكرة.
why.en: It explains why petrol cars won = why early electric cars failed.

items.src: Although the first electric cars appeared in the 1890s, they were soon overtaken by petrol cars, which could travel further and were cheaper to buy.

items.q: Best heading?

why.ar: ثلاثة إجراءات = Measures.
why.en: Three actions = measures.

items.src: To prevent flooding, engineers built higher river walls, planted trees upstream and created areas where water can safely spread.

items.q: The reef contains over 400 ____ of coral.

why.ar: 400 species (species شكلها واحد في المفرد والجمع).
why.en: 400 species (same form singular and plural).

items.src: The reef is home to more than 400 species of coral.

items.q: The scheme was very ____ at cutting waste.

why.ar: successful (صفة) لا success.
why.en: successful (adjective), not success.

items.src: The scheme proved remarkably successful in reducing waste.

items.q: Masks protected workers from ____.

why.ar: from the dust.
why.en: from the dust.

items.src: Workers wore masks to protect themselves from the dust.

items.q: The bridge links the island with the ____.

why.ar: the mainland.
why.en: the mainland.

items.src: The bridge connects the island to the mainland.

items.q: Dust lowers the ____ of solar panels.

why.ar: efficiency (اسم) لا efficient.
why.en: efficiency (noun), not efficient.

items.src: Solar panels must be cleaned regularly because dust reduces their efficiency.

items.q: People left the city following several serious ____.

why.ar: droughts بالجمع.
why.en: droughts — plural.

items.src: The ancient city was abandoned after a series of severe droughts.

items.q: Which matches?

hint.en: come into force = start to apply.

why.ar: come into force = starts to apply.
why.en: come into force = starts to apply.

items.src: The new law will come into force next January.
opts: The law starts to apply in January.
The law was cancelled in January.
The law was discussed in January.

items.q: Which matches?

why.ar: temporarily = لفترة قصيرة.
why.en: temporarily = for a short time.

items.src: The museum is temporarily closed for repairs.
opts: The museum is shut for a short period.

items.q: Which matches?

why.ar: الطلب أكبر من العرض = لا يكفي المنتج.
why.en: Demand exceeds supply = not enough product.

items.src: Demand for the product has outstripped supply.
opts: There is not enough of the product.
Too much of the product is made.

items.q: Which matches?

why.ar: a large crowd = many people.
why.en: a large crowd = many people.

items.src: The event attracted a large crowd.
opts: Many people came to the event.

items.q: Which matches?

why.ar: largely discredited = most experts no longer accept it.
why.en: largely discredited = most no longer accept it.

items.src: The theory has been largely discredited.
opts: Most experts no longer accept the theory.

items.q: Which matches?

why.ar: highly unpredictable = hard to know when it will rain.
why.en: highly unpredictable = hard to know when.

items.src: Rainfall in the region is highly unpredictable.
opts: It is hard to know when it will rain.

items.q: Which sentence is accurate?

why.ar: rose ثم levelled off.
why.en: rose, then levelled off.

items.src: Data: Exports grew from 5 million to 9 million, then stayed at 9 million.
opts: Exports rose and then levelled off.

items.q: Which features must be in your answer?

why.ar: الأعلى والأدنى والنمط العام هي الملامح الأساسية.
why.en: Highest, lowest and the main pattern are the key features.

items.src: Bar chart: 6 countries; Japan highest (80), Chad lowest (5).
opts: the highest and lowest values and the main pattern
all six values in a list

items.q: Which phrase is most precise?

why.ar: 45% = just under half. the majority تعني أكثر من النصف.
why.en: 45% = just under half; “the majority” means over half.

items.src: Pie charts: Coal was 45% of energy in 2000.

items.q: How should you begin?

hint.en: You don’t know the name; it’s formal.

why.ar: رسمي بدون اسم = Dear Sir or Madam.
why.en: Formal, no name = Dear Sir or Madam.

items.src: Task: Write to a hotel manager you have never met to complain about your stay.

items.q: Which introduction sentence is best?

why.ar: B تعرض الطرفين وتحدد موقفًا.
why.en: B acknowledges both and states a position.

items.src: Prompt: Is it better to live in a city or in the countryside?
opts: While rural life is calmer, I believe cities offer better opportunities for most young people.

items.q: Which sentence best EXPLAINS the point?

why.ar: B تشرح الآلية (حافلة بدل عشرات السيارات).
why.en: B explains the mechanism (one bus replaces many cars).

items.src: Topic sentence: Public transport reduces pollution.
opts: One bus can replace dozens of cars, so fewer exhaust fumes are released into the air.

items.q: How should you organise the body?

hint.en: The question asks for both sides.

why.ar: فقرة للمزايا وأخرى للعيوب.
why.en: A paragraph for each side.

items.src: What are the advantages and disadvantages of working from home?
opts: one paragraph of advantages, one of disadvantages

items.q: Where should your opinion appear?

hint.ar: المصحح يريد موقفًا واضحًا من البداية.
hint.en: Examiners want a clear position from the start.

why.ar: اذكر رأيك في المقدمة وأكده في الخاتمة.
why.en: State it in the introduction and confirm it in the conclusion.

items.src: Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
opts: in the introduction and the conclusion

items.q: Choose.

hint.ar: الخاتمة تلخص ولا تضيف أفكارًا جديدة.
hint.en: A conclusion summarises; no new ideas.

why.ar: In conclusion + تلخيص الموقف.
why.en: In conclusion + a summary of your position.

items.src: Which is the best conclusion opener?
opts: In conclusion, although…, I firmly believe that…

items.q: Correct the sentence.

why.ar: Peoples ← People.
why.en: Peoples → People.

items.src: Peoples in my city are friendly.
a: People in my city are friendly.

items.q: Correct the sentence.

hint.en: Don’t repeat the subject with a pronoun.

why.ar: احذف he.
why.en: Delete “he”.

items.src: My brother he works in a bank.
a: My brother works in a bank.

items.q: Correct the spelling.

why.ar: government.
why.en: government.

items.src: The goverment should make a decision about it.
a: The government should make a decision about it.

items.q: Choose the linker.

why.ar: because للسبب.
why.en: because shows cause.

items.src: Many people want to live in the city ____ there are more jobs there.

items.q: Choose the linker.

hint.ar: بعدها اسم (the high cost) لا جملة.
hint.en: A noun follows, not a clause.

why.ar: Despite + اسم.
why.en: Despite + noun.

items.src: ____ the high cost, the project was completed.

items.q: Choose the linker.

hint.en: The second is a result of the first.

why.ar: As a result للنتيجة.
why.en: As a result shows the result.

items.src: The city built new parks. ____ residents now exercise more.

items.q: Choose the linker.

why.ar: On the other hand لعرض وجهة مقابلة.
why.en: On the other hand introduces the opposite side.

items.src: Some say exams are stressful. ____, they motivate students to study.

items.q: Choose the linker.

why.ar: إضافة = In addition.
why.en: Addition = In addition.

items.src: Online courses are flexible. ____, they are often cheaper.

items.q: Which answer is best?

why.ar: B ممتدة وطبيعية.
why.en: B is extended and natural.

items.src: Examiner: Where do you live?
opts: I live in Riyadh, in a quiet neighbourhood in the north. It’s convenient because my university is only ten minutes away.

items.q: Which answer sounds most natural?

why.ar: B طبيعية وفيها سبب محلي، وA تكرر السؤال.
why.en: B is natural with a local reason; A repeats the question.

items.src: Examiner: Do you like rainy days?
opts: Yes, I like rainy days because rainy days are nice.
Actually, I love them. We don’t get much rain in Jeddah, so when it rains, everyone goes out to enjoy it.

items.q: Which answer best shows frequency language?

why.ar: hardly ever / usually / now and then.
why.en: hardly ever / usually / now and then.

items.src: Examiner: How often do you use public transport?
opts: Hardly ever, to be honest. I usually drive, but I take the metro now and then when traffic is bad.

items.q: Which tense must the answer use mainly?

why.ar: الماضي البسيط (I enjoyed, we used to).
why.en: Past simple (I enjoyed, we used to).

items.src: Examiner: Did you enjoy school as a child?

items.q: Which phrase best introduces a preference naturally?

why.ar: I’m really into… طبيعية. B فيها خطأ which… it.
why.en: “I’m really into…” is natural; B has the which… it error.

items.src: Examiner: What kind of music do you like?
opts: The music which I like it is…

items.q: Which choice of object is smartest?

hint.ar: اختر ما تستطيع الحديث عنه بسهولة.
hint.en: Choose what you can talk about easily.

why.ar: القصة والتفاصيل أهم من قيمة الشيء.
why.en: Stories and details matter more than value.

items.src: Cue card: Describe a useful object you own.
opts: one you can talk about for 2 minutes with a story
one you don’t know the English word for

items.q: Which phrase helps?

why.ar: As for… تنقلك للنقطة التالية بسلاسة.
why.en: “As for…” moves you smoothly to the next point.

items.src: You want to move from one point to the next.
opts: As for why it’s important to me, …

items.q: Which past tenses will you need most?

why.ar: الماضي البسيط للأحداث والمستمر للخلفية (I was walking when…).
why.en: Past simple for events, past continuous for background.

items.src: Cue card: Describe a time you helped someone.

items.q: Why is this a good opening?

hint.ar: البداية المباشرة توفر الوقت وتُظهر الثقة.
hint.en: A direct start saves time and shows confidence.

why.ar: تبدأ فورًا بوضوح دون تردد.
why.en: It starts immediately and clearly.

items.src: You start with: “I’d like to talk about…”

items.q: Which answer generalises correctly?

hint.ar: الجزء الثالث عن الناس عمومًا، بلا تعميم مطلق.
hint.en: Part 3 is about people in general, without absolutes.

why.ar: A عامة ومخففة (some people). C تعميم مطلق.
why.en: A is general and hedged; C is an absolute generalisation.

items.src: Examiner: Why do some people prefer to work alone?
opts: Some people find they concentrate better without interruptions, and they like controlling their own schedule.

items.q: Which answer is strongest?

why.ar: B تذكر مشكلتين ومثالًا.
why.en: B gives two problems and an example.

items.src: Examiner: What problems can tourism cause?
opts: It can push up housing costs for locals and damage fragile sites. For instance, some historic areas now limit visitor numbers to protect them.

items.q: Which phrase shows a balanced view?

why.ar: On the whole, yes, although… رأي متوازن.
why.en: “On the whole, yes, although…” is balanced.

items.src: Examiner: Should children learn a second language at primary school?

items.q: Which language fits a speculative question?

why.ar: I imagine… will probably للتوقع.
why.en: “I imagine… will probably” for speculation.

items.src: Examiner: How might cities change in the next 50 years?

items.q: What is the best way to extend your answer?

why.ar: السبب والمثال يحولان الجملة إلى إجابة جزء ثالث.
why.en: A reason and example turn a sentence into a Part 3 answer.

items.src: Examiner: Why is teamwork important at work?
opts: give a reason and a real-world example
